# Andrés Galdino

> Product Designer based in Bogotá, Colombia. 6+ years designing digital products end to end: research, information architecture, UX/UI, design systems, and developer handoff. Available for remote, hybrid, or on-site work.

## About

Andrés Galdino is a Product Designer with experience spanning UX/UI product design, design systems, and brand identity. His work is grounded in structured design thinking and hands-on execution — from strategy and naming through final production and web implementation.

Primary tool: Figma. Additional tools: Adobe Illustrator, Notion, Unity (prototyping), AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

Languages: Spanish (native), Portuguese (native, Brazilian family), English (intermediate, B1).

## Professional Experience

- **Chiper (ChiperOS)** — Product & Visual Designer, DesignOps. Jun 2024 – Mar 2025. Remote, B2B marketplace in Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, and Venezuela. Built a modular design system that reduced production cycles by 50% (from 15 days to 1 week) across 4 simultaneous markets, working with global brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever, and PepsiCo. Sole designer for the Brazilian market.

- **Reserva Natural Victoria Regia** — Digital Founder and Product Designer. 2019 – present. Leads the company's digital product end to end: information architecture, UX/UI in Figma, design system, brand, and the production website for an ecotourism nature reserve in the Colombian Amazon.

- **Moda Week International** — Graphic Designer and Brand Strategist. Jan 2018 – May 2022. Remote, US fashion media. Led visual and brand strategy: editorial design, motion graphics, and campaigns.

## Projects

- [Chiper](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/chiper/): Modular design system and DesignOps for a B2B marketplace: 50% shorter production cycles across 4 markets.
- [Victoria Regia](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/victoria-regia/): Brand identity, digital presence, and web management for an Amazonian nature reserve.
- [Amazonas Fashion Week](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/moda-week-international/): Project within Moda Week International: brand strategy and design for the most significant fashion event in the Colombian Amazon.
- [FarmalaxIA](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/farmalaxia/): Complete visual identity from scratch for a B2B SaaS startup serving independent drugstores.
- [Dreams](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/dreams/): Personal video game in Unity (videojuego personal en Unity), in development: building and dreamlike exploration, with an entry cinematic, movement mechanics, and a playable prototype.
- [LUMI](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/universitario/): UX/UI case study for an emotional wellness and gamification app for young adults.
- [Museo](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/museo/): Personal visual archive — photography, identity, design experiments, and creative exploration.
